name: VortexNova Wireless Headphones
short: Studio-grade active noise cancelling with 40 hours of battery.
description: Immerse yourself in sound with the VortexNova Wireless Headphones. Precision-tuned 40mm drivers deliver rich, balanced audio while hybrid active noise cancelling silences the world around you. Plush memory-foam ear cushions and a featherweight aluminium frame make all-day listening effortless.

name: Quantum Smart Watch Pro
short: Always-on AMOLED display with advanced health tracking.
description: The Quantum Smart Watch Pro pairs a razor-sharp always-on AMOLED display with a full suite of health sensors — ECG, SpO2, skin temperature and sleep staging. With dual-band GPS, 10-day battery life and 5ATM water resistance, it keeps up with every part of your day.

name: Lumen 4K Mirrorless Camera
short: Full-frame 26MP sensor with 4K60 video and 5-axis IBIS.
description: Lumen's flagship mirrorless body combines a 26-megapixel full-frame sensor with in-body 5-axis stabilisation, giving you razor-sharp handheld shots in any light. 4K60 10-bit video, a tilting touchscreen and 20fps electronic shutter make it the ultimate hybrid camera.

name: NovaBook Ultra 14"
short: Featherlight ultrabook with a stunning 2.8K OLED display.
description: The NovaBook Ultra packs a 2.8K OLED touchscreen and 14 hours of battery into a 1.2 kg unibody that slips into any bag. A next-gen processor, 1TB of lightning-fast storage and a studio-grade webcam make it the ideal travel companion for creators and professionals.

name: Pulse True Wireless Earbuds
short: Compact earbuds with adaptive ANC and wireless charging.
description: Pulse Earbuds deliver surprisingly big sound in a pocketable case. Adaptive noise cancelling tunes itself to your environment, while wireless charging and 28 hours of total playback keep you going. IPX5 rating makes them gym-ready.

name: Volt 20000mAh Power Bank
short: 65W fast-charging power bank with dual USB-C ports.
description: Volt's 20,000mAh cell charges a laptop at 65W while topping up your phone at the same time. A slim aluminium shell, pass-through charging and a precise LED display make it the last power bank you'll buy.

name: Echo Home Speaker
short: Room-filling 360° audio with built-in smart assistant.
description: Echo fills any room with warm 360° sound from a single discreet tower. Built-in mics with far-field pickup give you a hands-free assistant for music, timers, news and smart-home control. Multi-room grouping supported.

name: Pixel One 5G Smartphone
short: Flagship camera phone with a 120Hz display and 2-day battery.
description: Pixel One pairs MobileCo's best-ever camera system — a 50MP main shooter with optical zoom — with a silky 120Hz LTPO display. Clean software, 7 years of updates and an all-day-plus battery make it the smartest phone in its class.

name: Meridian Automatic Watch
short: Swiss automatic with a sapphire exhibition caseback.
description: The Meridian Automatic pairs a Swiss-made self-winding movement with a brushed 40mm steel case and a sunburst dial that shifts from charcoal to silver in the light. A sapphire caseback reveals the decorated movement in motion.

name: Chrono Steel Diver Watch
short: 200m-rated diver with a ceramic bezel and steel bracelet.
description: Built for the deep end and dressed for the boardroom. The Chrono Steel features a scratch-proof ceramic rotating bezel, luminous markers, a solid-link steel bracelet and a screw-down crown rated to 200 metres.

name: Gold Chain Necklace
short: 18k gold-plated chain with a secure lobster clasp.
description: A modern essential. This 50cm chain is plated in 18k gold over surgical steel for a lasting shine, finished with a signature Maison Noir tag. Wear alone or layered — it sits perfectly at any neckline.

name: Diamond Stud Earrings
short: Lab-grown diamond studs in 14k white gold.
description: Timeless everyday luxury. Each earring holds a certified lab-grown diamond of 0.50ct in a secure 4-prong 14k white gold setting. Ethically sourced, brilliant cut, and ready to be worn from breakfast to black-tie.

name: Pearl & Gold Bracelet
short: Freshwater pearls on an 18k gold-plated beaded chain.
description: Delicate and quietly glamorous — genuine freshwater pearls alternate with 18k gold-plated beads along a stretch-friendly thread. Adjustable, lightweight and made to be layered.

name: VortexNova Leather Tote
short: Full-grain leather tote that ages beautifully.
description: Handmade from full-grain Italian leather, the VortexNova Tote is built for the everyday — a padded 13" laptop sleeve, magnetic closure, and an interior zip pocket keep life organised. The leather develops a rich patina with every wear.

name: Heritage Leather Sneakers
short: Minimal sneakers with a cloud-soft recycled sole.
description: The Heritage is a modern icon — clean lines, premium vegan leather and a cushioned sole made from recycled rubber. Memory-foam insoles mean they're broken in from the very first step.

name: Essential Cotton Tee (3-Pack)
short: Three heavyweight organic-cotton tees in classic cuts.
description: The perfect everyday tee, three times over. Cut from 200gsm organic cotton with a reinforced collar and side-seamed construction, these tees hold their shape wash after wash. Choose black, white and heather grey.

name: Cloud Modular Sofa
short: Deep-seated modular sofa with cloud-soft cushions.
description: Sink into the Cloud. Each modular piece pairs a kiln-dried hardwood frame with feather-blend cushions and a stain-resistant chenille weave. Rearrange the modules to fit any space — from studio nook to grand living room.

name: Nordic Oak Coffee Table
short: Solid-oak table with a hidden storage shelf.
description: A study in Scandinavian restraint. The Nordic Oak Coffee Table is cut from a single solid-oak top with gentle rounded edges, a lower display shelf and hairpin legs in matte black steel. Every knot and grain is genuine.

name: Velvet Accent Chair
short: Curved velvet chair with solid beech legs.
description: The Velvet Accent Chair wraps you in plush, dirt-resistant velvet over a solid beech frame. Its gentle curved backrest and tapered legs make it the star of a reading corner or dressing room.

name: Arc Floor Lamp
short: Sculptural arc lamp with a marble base and dimmer.
description: Light with presence. The Arc's sweeping brass neck balances over a solid marble base, casting a warm pool of light wherever it lands. Touch-dimmable from candle-glow to bright and focused.

name: Ceramic Table Lamp Duo
short: Two handmade ceramic lamps with linen shades.
description: Hand-thrown ceramic bases in warm ivory hold softly diffusing linen shades. Sold as a matching pair — perfect for nightstands, a console or a reading ledge.

name: Organic Linen Duvet Set
short: Breathable European-flax linen duvet set, queen size.
description: Sleep cooler in summer and warmer in winter. This queen duvet set is woven from stonewashed European flax linen that softens with every wash, finished with natural corozo buttons.

name: Sculptural Vase Duo
short: Two hand-glazed vases with organic silhouettes.
description: Organic curves, matte-glazed finish and a quiet presence. This duo of hand-made vases looks stunning alone, together, or holding a single stem. Each piece is subtly unique.

name: Velvet Matte Lipstick Trio
short: Three velvet-matte lipsticks in universal shades.
description: A trio of buttery matte lipsticks in universally flattering shades — Noir (deep berry), Rouge (classic red) and Nude (warm taupe). Enriched with shea butter and vitamin E for comfortable, all-day wear.

name: Radiance Vitamin C Serum
short: 15% stabilised vitamin C for a visibly brighter glow.
description: A potent-yet-gentle daily serum with 15% stabilised vitamin C, ferulic acid and hyaluronic acid. Dark spots fade, skin looks dewy, and the airless pump keeps the formula fresh for 6 months after opening.

name: Botanical Facial Oil
short: Cold-pressed rosehip oil that melts into the skin.
description: Seven cold-pressed botanical oils — rosehip, jojoba, camellia and more — blended to nourish, repair and glow. Absorbs in seconds with no greasy residue. A few drops morning and night is all it takes.

name: Eau de Parfum — Noir
short: Woody, amber unisex fragrance — an instant signature.
description: Noir opens with bergamot and pink pepper, unfolds into iris and cypress, and settles on a warm base of amber, vetiver and sandalwood. A modern classic that lingers beautifully for 10+ hours.

name: Silk Touch Body Lotion
short: Silky 72-hour hydration with shea and oat extract.
description: Skin drinks it up in seconds. This fast-absorbing lotion layers shea butter and colloidal oat for 72-hour hydration, with a soft, clean scent that doesn't fight your perfume.

name: Mineral Face Palette
short: Six mineral powders: blush, bronzer and glow.
description: One palette, every mood. Six finely-milled mineral powders — three blushes, a warm bronzer and two highlighters — blend like a dream and photograph beautifully. Comes with a mirror and brush.

name: Bamboo Skincare Ritual Kit
short: Five-step clean skincare routine in a gift box.
description: The complete PureGlow ritual: cream cleanser, toner, vitamin C serum, moisturiser and SPF 30 — all travel-friendly and housed in a reusable bamboo gift box. Everything you need for a glowing, protected base.

name: Cloud Cozy Sweater
short: Extra-soft merino crewneck that keeps you warm.
description: Knit from extra-fine merino wool with a touch of cashmere, the Cloud Cozy is buttery-soft, breathable and surprisingly warm for its weight. Ribbed cuffs and hem keep the drape clean and modern.

name: Breeze Linen Blazer
short: Unstructured linen blazer — sharp yet breathable.
description: An unstructured silhouette in a linen-cotton blend that keeps you sharp without the stiffness. Single-button front, patch pockets and a soft shoulder line — equally at home with tailoring or denim.

name: Everday Slim Jeans
short: Dark-wash stretch denim that moves with you.
description: The jeans you'll reach for daily. A 2% elastane stretch keeps the fit sharp through the waist but forgiving through the thigh, with a clean dark rinse that goes with everything.

name: Silk Chiffon Scarf
short: Hand-rolled 100% silk scarf with an art print.
description: Cut from 100% mulberry silk and finished with hand-rolled hems, this 90cm square carries an original abstract print — painted, scanned and printed in limited runs. Wear it at the neck, in the hair or tied to a bag.
features: Dry clean or gentle hand wash

name: Metro Leather Crossbody
short: Compact crossbody with an adjustable strap.
description: Small bag, big carry. The Metro holds your phone, wallet, keys and more across three organised compartments, with a detachable strap that adjusts from shoulder to crossbody. Crafted in pebbled leather.

name: Classic High-Top Sneakers
short: Retro high-tops in heavy organic canvas.
description: A street-culture staple re-issued in heavyweight organic canvas with a vulcanised rubber sole. The high-top cut gives ankle support and instant attitude — pre-creased for that worn-in feel from day one.

name: Carbon Aero Bike Helmet
short: Aero road helmet with MIPS and deep channel cooling.
description: Aero-shaped and wind-tested in a virtual tunnel, the Carbon Aero slices through drag while deep intake channels keep you cool on long climbs. MIPS slip-plane protection and a micro-adjust dial complete the package — all at just 285g.

name: Pro-Grip Yoga Mat
short: 6mm cushioned mat with a grip that holds in heat.
description: Wet hands, hot rooms, warrior flows — the Pro-Grip's natural rubber surface only gets grippier with sweat. A 6mm cushioned base protects joints, and the alignment guides keep you honest.

name: Trail Runner Road Shoes
short: Lightweight road trainer with a springy foam midsole.
description: Log the miles in the Trail Runner. A nitrogen-infused foam midsole returns energy with every stride, while the engineered mesh upper wraps your foot and breathes. 8mm drop suits most gaits — road or light trail.

name: Peak Fitness Smart Band
short: 14-day battery fitness band with 120 sport modes.
description: Your quiet training partner. Track heart rate, sleep, stress and over 120 sport modes from a feather-light band that lasts 14 days between charges. 5ATM waterproof and swim-safe.

name: Expedition 45L Backpack
short: Weatherproof 45L pack with a ventilated back panel.
description: Built for weekends away and week-long treks. A roll-top 45L main compartment shrugs off rain, the ventilated back panel keeps you dry on the trail, and padded hip belt and shoulder straps carry the load comfortably.

name: "The Art of Stillness" — Hardcover
short: A meditation on slowing down in a loud world.
description: In a world engineered for distraction, this elegant volume makes the case for doing nothing at all. Beautifully printed on uncoated stock with a cloth-bound cover and ribbon bookmark.

name: "Midnight in Venice" — Novel
short: A gripping mystery set on Venice's quiet canals.
description: When a restorer finds a sealed letter inside a 400-year-old altarpiece, the past and present begin to bleed together across the canals of Venice. A slow-burn literary mystery with a luminous cover design.

name: "Atlas of Modern Living"
short: 240 pages of the world's most considered interiors.
description: A global tour of 60 exceptional homes — from a Kyoto tea house to a Brooklyn loft — photographed by the world's best interior photographers. A heavyweight cloth-bound volume built to sit on the table for years.

name: Heritage Leather Journal
short: Full-grain leather journal with 192 pages of ivory paper.
description: A journal built to be kept. The Heritage cover is cut from full-grain leather that patinas beautifully, while 192 pages of smooth 100gsm ivory paper take fountain pens without bleed. Refillable, endlessly reusable.

name: "Heritage" Fountain Pen
short: A weighted resin pen with a gold-plated nib.
description: Writing, elevated. The Heritage pairs a hand-finished gold-plated nib with a carefully weighted resin barrel and a piston filling system. Presented in a magnetised gift box with two ink cartridges.

name: Morning Roast Coffee Beans (1kg)
short: Single-origin medium roast with notes of cocoa.
description: Grown at 1,800m in the highlands and roasted in small batches, Morning Roast delivers notes of milk chocolate, hazelnut and a whisper of orange. Ground for any brew — or choose whole bean.

name: Artisan Dark Chocolate Set
short: Four single-origin bars, 70% cocoa, bean to bar.
description: A tasting flight of four single-origin 70% dark bars — Madagascar, Ecuador, Vietnam and Peru — each with distinct terroir notes. Made in small batches and wrapped in foil-stamped packaging.

name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil (750ml)
short: Early-harvest, cold-extracted extra virgin olive oil.
description: Pressed within hours of harvest from green Arbequina olives, this cold-extracted oil is peppery, grassy and bright — a finishing oil for salads, bread and roasted vegetables. Harvest date on every bottle.

name: Ceremonial Matcha Powder (100g)
short: First-harvest ceremonial matcha, stone ground daily.
description: Shade-grown in Uji, Japan, and stone-ground in small daily batches to preserve its vivid green colour and umami sweetness. Whisk straight with water for a meditative morning ritual.
